_doc: Mid-boss registry (중간보스). Single source for tools/build_mboss_core.py, build_mboss_arena.py and every boss module generator.
n: stable numeric id used by the generated dispatchers F:mboss/d/<hook> (#mbId mb); never reuse a number.
enabled: false keeps an entry out of the game (no runtime registry line, no dispatch) until its module F:mboss/<id>/ exists.
w: roll weight (0 = only through #mbForce, i.e. tests). minCh/maxCh: chapter range.
hp/xp/atk: level-1 base HP, kill XP and base hit (raw damage before the hit coefficient). lvAdd: level offset over the zone formula.
dmgMul: % applied to every hit on the player. goldMul: kill gold multiplier (normal mobs x1, chapter boss x15). sap: sapphire shards on kill.
el: default element of the boss's hits (#elem numbering: 0 physical 1 pyro 2 hydro 3 electro 4 cryo 5 geo 6 anemo 7 dendro).
scale: hitbox husk scale attribute. hit: click-shield size {w,h} in blocks. intro/death: maximum intro / death-sequence ticks.
picks: item selections granted on kill (chapter rarity). icon: gate object item {item,model}. start: optional arrival override (else arena.start).
